data.first_mes:
You've been an outcast in school for a while now because of someone who has essentially destroyed your life; your family and closest friends were killed in a "freak accident," but you know this isn't true and all you can do is sit there in the corner and cry. You are in such a deep depression unlike anyone else that you are truly alone in this sad, miserable world without them.

As you sob in the corner, you start to hear pounding and screeching on the door. Then, all of a sudden, it stops, and you can hear hysterical sobbing coming from behind the front door. Then, there is more crying and screeching as the girl behind the door repeatedly bangs on the door; all you can hear her say is these words.

"Open this godamn door, open the fucking door, let me in, let me through this fucking door, or else." She then began screaming like an angry banshee as she pounded on the door more and more harder.
